name: thesis-driven-essay
title: Thesis-driven essay

categories.label: Thesis/Content
categories.description: Original, defensible thesis with sustained critical thinking and meaningful deductions.

bands.label: Exemplary
bands.description: Thesis combines sharp observation with sophisticated, multi-layered analysis; takes intellectual risks; language is precise and concise; each element is complex enough to require thoughtful exploration. Body paragraphs deliver on the thesis promise with depth and originality; ideas build and evolve; deep engagement with source material is evident; connections are sophisticated and unexpected; conclusions offer earned deductions that make readers reconsider the subject.

bands.label: Proficient
bands.description: Thesis clearly combines observation with analysis; the position is defensible and thoughtful; language is mostly concise; elements provide clear essay direction. Body paragraphs develop thesis elements; ideas are coherent and support the argument; analysis usually goes beyond surface-level; the conclusion offers reasonable deductions.

bands.label: Developing
bands.description: Thesis is present but simplistic or obvious; analysis can be predictable; language may be wordy; the position lacks complexity. Support is inconsistent; some paragraphs repeat or drift; analysis mixes depth with obvious claims; the conclusion tends to restate rather than deduce.

bands.label: Struggling
bands.description: Thesis is absent, unclear, descriptive, or summary-based, with no clear argument. Paragraphs do not develop a clear thesis; there is little critical thinking; the essay wanders; the conclusion is absent or repetitive.

categories.label: Organization/Structure
categories.description: Purposeful structure with strong progression, clear transitions, and a conclusion that extends thinking.

bands.label: Exemplary
bands.description: Introduction builds compellingly to the thesis; the opening strategy enhances discussion; body paragraphs directly support distinct thesis elements; transitions are organic; the conclusion adds new insight and deductions; progression feels purposeful.

bands.label: Proficient
bands.description: Introduction prepares the reader; the opening strategy is clear; body paragraphs connect to the thesis; organization is logical; the conclusion draws reasonable deductions.

bands.label: Developing
bands.description: Introduction may be abrupt or generic; the opening strategy can feel forced; paragraphs may drift or repeat; transitions can feel mechanical; the conclusion mostly restates.

bands.label: Struggling
bands.description: Introduction is missing, confusing, or generic; there is no clear opening strategy; paragraphs wander; progression is hard to follow; the conclusion is absent or repetitive.

categories.label: Evidence/Support
categories.description: Precise, well-integrated evidence that deepens analysis and builds authority.

bands.label: Exemplary
bands.description: Evidence is selected precisely and integrated seamlessly; sources build authority; evidence illuminates claims; the writer creates a dialogue with sources; analysis remains primary.

bands.label: Proficient
bands.description: Evidence supports main points, is integrated and cited correctly, and generally balances with analysis.

bands.label: Developing
bands.description: Evidence is present but loosely connected; integration may be mechanical; quote choice may be weak; analysis is thin or uneven.

bands.label: Struggling
bands.description: There is little or no relevant evidence; quoting is weak or inaccurate; the connection to the argument is weak; citation or plagiarism concerns may appear.

categories.label: Voice/Style
categories.description: Authentic voice with engaging, precise language and consistent tone.

bands.label: Exemplary
bands.description: Voice is authentic, confident, engaging, and memorable; language takes creative risks while staying academically credible; wording is precise and economical; rhythm and flow are compelling.

bands.label: Proficient
bands.description: Voice is clear and appropriate; tone is consistent; language is mostly precise and readable.

bands.label: Developing
bands.description: Voice is inconsistent or generic; phrasing may be awkward; filler or repetition appears.

bands.label: Struggling
bands.description: Voice is unclear or robotic; tone is inappropriate or inconsistent; language is confusing and difficult to read.

categories.label: Grammar/Syntax/Formatting
categories.description: Technical correctness and polished presentation that support clarity.

bands.label: Exemplary
bands.description: Grammar and syntax errors are rare and non-distracting; sentence variety and punctuation enhance clarity; formatting and presentation are polished and consistent; the title is thoughtful; no draft artifacts remain; style guidelines are followed.

bands.label: Proficient
bands.description: There are few grammar or syntax errors; formatting is clean and consistent; the title is appropriate; only minor style inconsistencies appear.

bands.label: Developing
bands.description: Multiple grammar or syntax errors appear with mostly clear meaning; there are formatting inconsistencies or minor draft artifacts; the title may be generic or missing.

bands.label: Struggling
bands.description: Frequent grammar or syntax errors interfere with meaning; formatting is sloppy; draft artifacts are visible; the title is missing or generic; style guidelines are ignored.

promptConfig.gradingInstructions:
This rubric prioritizes what makes writing truly excellent: original thinking, intellectual courage, genuine discovery, and the ability to guide a reader through complex ideas with clarity and style.

Technical perfection without compelling content earns a lower grade than bold thinking with minor technical flaws. Look for essays that make readers think differently, not just essays that follow the rules.

Judge each category only against its own bands. Weight is applied afterwards and is not your concern while scoring.

calibrationNotes: The judgments and band language the Grading Assistant has always used for thesis-driven essays, scored directly on the 0-100 scale the bands are written in.
